matching_scale: At the upper Dirac mass cluster impose the original triangular C, the two real positive H entries and the two active Dirac columns in the common holomorphic weak basis; use the actual split clusters as matching scales, tree Wilson matching, and the full dimension-five one-loop tensor equations. These are renormalized graph data at a specified scale.
angle_and_phase_holdout: Two JUNO squared mass gaps set two positive H coefficients. No oscillation angle or CP sign is used to calibrate these coefficients. Kinematic normal ordering and the three previously registered charged flavour orientations remain inputs.
